component_state.working_tree_note: These component files were uncommitted at capture; the file hashes identify the tested state.

scope: Component-level validation of the T17 trace-only residual local diagnostic helper; it is not public query-path behavior.
tested_guarantees: Only explicitly supplied current missing required slots are eligible; an empty set does not expand into all requirements, and stale slot IDs fail closed.
The component reuses only an exact request-scoped atomic QueryVectorBundle binding and does not invoke a provider embedding call.
At most one bounded local diagnostic round is performed, with a capped slot count; whole-question retry and full rerank are skipped.
Dense/sparse local hits, candidate-missing IDs, and ResidualSourceMappingReceipt values are diagnostics only.
The existing selected evidence is preserved and no candidate Episode is appended or materialized.
When a local diagnostic pass completes, the component stops with semantic_verifier_unavailable.

test_runs.command: $env:PYTHONPATH='.;src'; & 'C:\Users\Admin\Documents\chat_bot\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -m unittest -v tests.test_residual_gap_repair_t17 tests.test_recall_v3_sqlite_preflight tests.test_recall_v3_replay_executor tests.test_readonly_replay_database tests.test_authoritative_requirements tests.test_query_vector_bundle_v3 tests.test_engine_contribution_selector_v3

not_tested_or_not_claimed: Candidate-missing Source recovery or candidate evidence delivery.
Semantic proof that a Source fact supports a specific slot.
Live provider, corpus import, benchmark, full-corpus, or full T17 acceptance results.
limitations: A typed receipt plus a current source-fact identity match is structural provenance diagnostics, not a trusted semantic-verifier capability.
No ranking, candidate-missing hint, dense/sparse hit, source-window hit, graph-path result, or receipt may become delivered evidence in this component.
A real candidate-missing Source-recovery acceptance test remains blocked until a trusted per-span semantic verifier is introduced.
